data.name: CRUSH!
data.detailed_description:
1V1 COUCH MAYHEM — TWO PLAYERS, ONE VEHICLE

A competitive couch party game for two players. You and your rival share one unstoppable machine of destruction. Fight for control over steering, smash through each other's neighborhoods, and crush adorable tiny animals. But if you don't work together to dodge the cops, you both lose. Matches last less than 3 minutes.

It’s 1v1. But if you don’t work together, you both lose.

Take control of the "Giant Machine of Peacekeeping" and turn a peaceful solarpunk paradise into a scrap heap. In this chaotic couch party game, you and your opponent are physically fighting over shared controls. One moment you’re driving toward your rival's town to flatten it; the next, you’re jamming their input to steal the steering wheel.

WRECK YOUR RIVAL

Smash through buildings, demolish neighborhoods, and scatter the populations of tiny adorable animals. Every structure you destroy brings you closer to victory—and one step closer to making your friend rage-quit.

DODGE THE LAW

You're causing havoc in a utopia, and the Eco Police don't approve. Hazards and cops will try to shut down the match. You’ll have to momentarily stop fighting your friend to boost, jump, and evade the law. Get caught, and you both lose. Cooperation is mandatory, even if betrayal is more fun.

FAST & FRANTIC

No complicated combos. No 30-minute slogs. Matches are designed to be over in under 3 minutes, perfect for tournament play, trash talk, and "just one more round."

CHOOSE YOUR CREW

Pick your faction: Hyena, Toad, Bat, or Deer. Each represents a distinct neighborhood that you’ll either be defending or demolishing depending on who is driving.
